sbmFragment.description:
One debris fragment produced by a breakup event.

Vector components are expressed in the parent SBM.REF_FRAME axes.
Position and velocity are the fragment's state at SBM.EPOCH, i.e. the
parent state plus the ejection delta-V, before any propagation.

ORIGIN.description: Which parent body this fragment came from.

AM_RATIO_M2_PER_KG.description: Area-to-mass ratio in square meters per kilogram.

AREA_M2.description: Average cross-sectional area in square meters.

DELTA_V_MAG_M_PER_S.description: Magnitude of the ejection delta-V in meters per second.

DELTA_V_X_M_PER_S.description: Ejection delta-V X component in meters per second.

DELTA_V_Y_M_PER_S.description: Ejection delta-V Y component in meters per second.

DELTA_V_Z_M_PER_S.description: Ejection delta-V Z component in meters per second.

POSITION_X_KM.description: Fragment position X component in kilometers.

POSITION_Y_KM.description: Fragment position Y component in kilometers.

POSITION_Z_KM.description: Fragment position Z component in kilometers.

VELOCITY_X_KM_PER_S.description: Fragment velocity X component in kilometers per second.

VELOCITY_Y_KM_PER_S.description: Fragment velocity Y component in kilometers per second.

VELOCITY_Z_KM_PER_S.description: Fragment velocity Z component in kilometers per second.

SBM.description:
Satellite Breakup Model

One SBM record is a single on-orbit fragmentation event — an explosion or
a collision — together with the debris population a breakup model produced
for it. It carries the model inputs (parent states, masses, relative
velocity, object class, cutoff, seed) so the population is reproducible,
and the resulting fragments in FRAGMENTS.

Units on the wire: parent and fragment position are KILOMETERS, parent and
fragment velocity are KILOMETERS PER SECOND (matching $OMM, $OEM, $OCM and
$CDM state conventions); ejection delta-V, relative velocity and
characteristic length are METERS PER SECOND and METERS respectively
(matching the breakup-model literature). Every field name states its unit.

This record describes an ON-ORBIT breakup. Atmospheric reentry breakup and
demise stay in $RDM/$REM; a business-loss classification of the event stays
in $OOE.

CREATION_DATE.description: Message creation date in ISO 8601 UTC format.

OBJECT_CLASS.description: Parent object class used to select model coefficients.

EPOCH.description:
Event epoch in ISO 8601 UTC format. Fragment states are given at this
epoch.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used by all epochs.

REF_FRAME.description: Reference frame for all position, velocity and delta-V components.

OBJECT_ID.description: Target international designator or producer object identifier.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
Target satellite catalog number. Joins to CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID and
OMM.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

IMPACTOR_OBJECT_NAME.description: Impactor object name. COLLISION events only.

IMPACTOR_NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Impactor satellite catalog number. COLLISION events only. 0 when unbound.

IMPACTOR_MASS_KG.description: Impactor mass in kilograms. COLLISION events only.

IMPACTOR_L_C_M.description: Impactor characteristic length in meters. COLLISION events only.

RELATIVE_VELOCITY_M_PER_S.description: Collision relative velocity in meters per second. COLLISION events only.

CATASTROPHIC.description:
True when the collision energy-to-mass ratio met the catastrophic
threshold and both bodies were fully fragmented.

PARENT_POSITION_X_KM.description: Parent position X component in kilometers at EPOCH.

PARENT_POSITION_Y_KM.description: Parent position Y component in kilometers at EPOCH.

PARENT_POSITION_Z_KM.description: Parent position Z component in kilometers at EPOCH.

PARENT_VELOCITY_X_KM_PER_S.description: Parent velocity X component in kilometers per second at EPOCH.

PARENT_VELOCITY_Y_KM_PER_S.description: Parent velocity Y component in kilometers per second at EPOCH.

PARENT_VELOCITY_Z_KM_PER_S.description: Parent velocity Z component in kilometers per second at EPOCH.

MIN_LC_M.description:
Lower characteristic-length cutoff in meters. Fragments smaller than
this were not generated.

SEED.description:
Random number generator seed. A producer that reports the same
MODEL_NAME, MODEL_VERSION, inputs and SEED must reproduce FRAGMENTS
exactly.

FRAGMENT_COUNT.description:
Number of fragments generated. Equals the length of FRAGMENTS when the
population is carried in this record.

INPUT_MASS_KG.description: Total parent mass fed to the model in kilograms.

OUTPUT_MASS_KG.description: Total mass carried by the generated fragments in kilograms.
